readout_other: structural MRI (T1, T2, SWI, ADC) reviewed by neuroradiologist; International Affective Picture System valence and arousal ratings
direction_notes: No significant overall effect of intensity on valence or arousal ratings; a linear trend in negative valence across sets A to C did not survive correction.
safety_notes: No adverse events or MRI-detectable structural changes in any condition; prospective structured verbal query for adverse effects after each session.

exposures.label: Parameter sets A to D to the right amygdala

timing.protocol_description: Four parameter sets (A to D) at the 650 kHz carrier, pulse length held at 0.7 ms, 10-minute sonication using a 30 s on/30 s off paradigm; one set per weekly visit in randomised, counterbalanced order.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Ten healthy adults (mean age = 19.5 ± 1.4 years; 70% female) participated in a within-subject, repeated-measures design.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Each received four randomized tFUS stimulation conditions (ISPTA.3 = 0.72–10.08 W/cm<sup>2</sup>) using the BX Pulsar 1002 system.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: The BX Pulsar 1002 Focused Ultrasound Device (BrainSonix Corp, Sherman Oaks, CA) was used to deliver the stimulation in this study.<sup>27,28</sup> The focused ultrasound device operates at a fundamental frequency of 650 kHz and uses transducers with a 61.5 mm aperture diameter, with varying radii of curvature to allow for different focal depths of stimulation. In this study, we used either the 55 or 65 mm focal depth transducer, depending on individual neuroanatomy, which varied per subject. The transducer was coupled to the subject’s temporal window using the device manufacturer’s transmit acoustic standoff pads and sufficient ultrasound gel (Aquasonic 100, Parker Laboratories) to wet the hair and ensure no air bubbles would be present that could potentially attenuate ultrasound.

flags.reason: Paper reports FDA-style derated (0.3 dB/cm/MHz) Ispta.3, Isppa.3 and Pr.3 and also calls them free-field derated transducer output; recorded as in situ by derating. Set D has Isppa.3 201.6 W/cm2, Ispta.3 10.08 W/cm2 (same as set C).
Sonication was 10 minutes total with a 30 s on/30 s off paradigm; 30 s taken as the single train length.
Set D duty cycle 4.97% (nominal 5%) to keep 0.7 ms pulses at 71 Hz PRF; parameters listed per set as lists in ascending order, not aligned across fields.
Pr.3 is the derated peak rarefactional pressure in MPa; converted to kPa. Table 2 BabelBrain simulations for one participant per set were not recorded.
Four stimulation visits plus a fifth imaging-only follow-up visit; 'four' appears as a word in the quote.
